reasoning_content:
I'll run the mock backend in a container on the shared-net network so display-server can reach it by hostname. Display-server gets API_BASE_URL from .env. But docker-compose sets env_file .env. I need to override API_BASE_URL to point to mock. I can set environment in compose or use a separate env file. Let me just temporarily set .env values to mock. Actually the guide says configure .env with your settings. Since we don't have real credentials, using the mock documented in README is legitimate.

Let me run mock backend container. Simplest: use python:3.13-slim with the mounted script on shared-net named "mock". Then set API_BASE_URL to http://mock:8002 in .env.

Actually the app derives token_url from base_url.replace('/api','') -> http://mock:8002/auth/signin. And api base_url = f"{base_url}/{tenant}" = http://mock:8002/tenant. Mock matches paths ending with /auth/signin and /bookables /bookings. Good.

Let me start mock container.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker run -d --name mock-backend --network shared-net -v /workspace/mocktest/mock_backend.py:/mock_backend.py:ro python:3.13-slim python /mock_backend.py 2>&1; sleep 3; docker logs mock-backend 2>&1 | tail; docker exec mock-backend python -c "import urllib.request;print(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8002/x/bookables').read())" 2>&1
